channel.title: MassPermits — coverage ended: Douglas, MA
channel.description: MassPermits no longer receives building-permit records for Douglas, MA. This feed has stopped and is kept only so its address does not break. The last permit this feed carried was issued 2026-07-29. It is not a current feed and must not be read as one. Live coverage is listed at https://masspermits.com/permits/ and the sources still publishing are itemised at https://masspermits.com/research/coverage.
channel.dc:source: Compiled from public municipal building-permit records published by Massachusetts cities and towns.
